Fresh bounded replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/reproduce_nuclei.py directly evaluates all 64 basis associators of the four-element example and exhausts coefficient vectors in characteristics 2, 3 and 5. The four dimensions are (2,3,2,2), (2,3,2,0), (2,3,2,0).
correctness.rationale: On the group ring put δ=1−φ and let α and β be induced by φ and δ. Expanding both products yields [u,v,w]=αβ(v)(α²(u)β(w)−α(u)β²(w)). In k[G], the shifts in β(X^g)−β²(X^g) range over δφ(G)=H, and those in α²(X^g)−α(X^g) range over −φδ(G)=H; multiplying by monomial units shows each family generates the same translation ideal. Its annihilator consists exactly of coefficients constant on H-cosets, even in modular characteristic. Substituting the monomial X^0 in the other slots first isolates α(u)=u on the left and β(w)=β²(w) on the right. The left condition then reduces to the annihilator (which α fixes); the middle reduces to β(v) supported on H and lying in the annihilator, hence a multiple of Ω_H; the right needs both that line condition and β-fixity. If H₂ is proper, a coefficient on H minus H₂ makes the latter condition impossible for a nonzero multiple, without dividing by |H|. The induced surjection G/H→H/H₂ sends a coset sum to b times a coset sum on the target, so has rank b or zero as asserted on U_H. This proves the dimensions and jump, including trivial H, connected H=G, and characteristic zero. The unipotent example has a=b=p and verifies the arbitrary jump size.
residual_risks: The fresh replay checks only the four-element example; the general conclusion rests on the symbolic proof, not on the frozen 346-case test or on any formal verification.

value.rationale: Determining all slots and the intersection on a natural non-Latin family gives an effective invariant from two subgroup images, not a table of isolated examples.
